title: Certificates of Deposit: interest repointing does not apply where the maturity payout names the same closed account
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to a Certificates of Deposit certificate whose interest is paid out to an account that has been closed. It marks out the certificates to which interest repointing does not apply.

## Rule

A certificate whose maturity instruction is itself pay out to checking or pay out to savings, on that same closed payout account, is outside interest repointing. Its payout account is replaced together with the maturity instruction, under the rules for maturity payout instructions that name a closed account, and nothing is written under interest repointing.

## Condition table

| Interest paid to a closed payout account | Maturity instruction on record | Interest repointing applies? |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Pay out to checking or pay out to savings, on the same account | No; nothing is written under interest repointing |
| Yes | Automatic renewal | Yes |
| Yes | Mail a check | Yes |

## Cases (hypothetical certificates)

- Interest and maturity proceeds both go to the owner's savings account, which is now closed. Interest repointing does not apply; the account is replaced together with the maturity instruction.
- Interest goes to the owner's closed checking account, and the certificate is set to renew automatically. Interest repointing applies.
